svg.title: Folding a noisy light curve
svg.desc: Top: a noisy light curve over four orbits in which shallow transits cannot be seen. Bottom: the same points folded on the period and averaged, which reveals a clear dip.
svg.text: 1. Raw measurements: four shallow transits hidden in the noise
▲ where the transits are (hard to see!)
2. Folded on the right period: every transit stacked, then averaged
Averaging n points shrinks the scatter by √n, so the dip appears.
